oneLiner: Proofhand replaces image puzzles on sign-up, login and contact forms with an invisible proof-of-work check and one server-side verification.
definition: Proofhand is a CAPTCHA replacement: the visitor's browser solves a small proof-of-work challenge silently, the form carries a token, and the server verifies it once with a call shaped like reCAPTCHA's siteverify.
audience: Product, growth and platform teams, publishers and documentation sites

features.name: Invisible challenge
features.detail: A small proof-of-work check runs in the visitor's browser while the page loads.

features.name: Token on the form
features.detail: The form carries a token the visitor never sees.

features.name: One verification
features.detail: The server verifies the token once, with a request shaped like reCAPTCHA's siteverify.

features.detail: It replaces puzzles on sign-up, login and contact forms without a redesign.

Form abandonment no longer caused by verification

faqs.question: What is Proofhand?
faqs.answer: Proofhand replaces image puzzles on sign-up, login and contact forms with an invisible proof-of-work check: the browser solves it silently, the form carries a token, and the server verifies that token once.

faqs.question: Is Proofhand a CAPTCHA replacement?
faqs.answer: Yes. It does the same job as reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha without asking a real visitor to identify traffic lights, and the server-side verification call is shaped like reCAPTCHA's siteverify.

faqs.question: How much does Proofhand cost?
faqs.answer: There is a free tier. IntegrityRuntime Pro is $49 a month, AgentPass Pro is $99 a month, Hardware Gateway Pro is $149 a month and Enterprise is $299 a month.

faqs.question: Does it stop bots as well as a puzzle does?
faqs.answer: Bots that solve puzzles with paid services get through those puzzles anyway; a proof-of-work check costs a machine real computation while costing a person nothing.

faqs.question: Will it work with my existing form?
faqs.answer: Yes. The change is a token on the form and one verification call on the server, so the form itself does not need redesigning.

faqs.question: Can I charge AI crawlers instead of blocking them?
faqs.answer: Yes. Proofhand lets a site make crawlers either pay for access or stay out, instead of blocking all automation or allowing all of it.

faqs.question: Is Proofhand accessible?
faqs.answer: It asks nothing of the visitor beyond submitting the form, so there is no visual or motor task to fail.
